header.name: InvUI button.send notification probe (DISPOSABLE WORLD ONLY)
header.description: Unverified button.send probe: adds one experimental button and one positive-control label to the vanilla chest screen panels so you can watch whether pressing the button produces a '!invui:' chat notification that the probe behavior pack observes. No interaction control and no item protection. Normal chests may show the same button and label. No guarantee that any notification is sent. Use only in a disposable world.
